pages.title: Folded bark
pages.text: Approach a living growth with pale shutters and an amber lining.

pages.title: A useful residue
pages.text: Collect a dormant flake or refine your first essence.

pages.title: The threshold
pages.text: Use a terminal and examine the charters it can offer.

pages.title: The compass
pages.text: Enter an expedition portal and take its issued compass.

pages.title: Settled marks
pages.text: Use a checkpoint rather than merely passing its light.

pages.title: Sealed cargo
pages.text: Reach a recovery site and take possession of its sealed parcel.

pages.title: Hold the line
pages.text: Activate a checkpoint whose charter calls for a deployed device.

pages.title: A sealed sample
pages.text: Draw a sample with an assay kit, or notice the first effects of exposure.

pages.title: Being noticed
pages.text: Remain in affected country long enough for it to answer your presence.

pages.title: Bring it home
pages.text: Use extraction after the charter's required work is complete.

pages.title: At the last marker
pages.text: Follow a confrontation charter until its final mark answers.

pages.title: After silence
pages.text: Return to country whose campaign has been brought to a close.

pages.title: Things brought back
pages.text: Recover a living Shutter Bloom, or obtain an instrument made from one.
